# 00000004744

**English.** Definition: A transcendental Brauer class is a class with nonalgebraic cohomological origin. Conjecture: The transcendental classes of a low Picard rank K3 are generated by explicit endomorphisms of the intermediate Jacobian, and the generator exponent is the smallest prime factor of the transcendence degree. (Jacobian generation of transcendental Brauer classes)

**中文。** 定义：超越 Brauer 类指非代数上同调来源的类。猜想：低 Picard 秩 K3 的超越类由中间 Jacobian 的显式自同态生成,生成元指数为超越次数的最小素因子。（超越 Brauer 的 Jacobian 生成）
